title: M.Sc. Thesis: Balancing Data Utility and Privacy in Medical Synthetic Data Generation
description: Compared GAN- and LLM-based models for a medical tabular dataset, evaluating trade-offs across fidelity, utility, and privacy dimensions. Contributed towards a unified evaluation framework for synthetic medical data, assessing fidelity, utility, and privacy for tabular data.

title: E-commerce chatbot using Agentic AI
description: Built an agentic AI chatbot using LangChain and Gemini for multi-step reasoning across product search, order lookup, and customer support. Implemented FastAPI tool-calling architecture, connecting the LLM agent to live backend services for real-time data retrieval and action execution.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Designed and developed a fully responsive single-page portfolio website in React.js to showcase skills, projects and achievements. Built reusable components with dynamic rendering for maintainability and scalability, achieving 100% Lighthouse scores in performance and accessibility.

title: Biometric Authenticator App
description: Integrated fingerprint sensor SDKs and image-based authentication for secure user verification. Conducted a comparative analysis of leading SDKs (Neurotech, Dermalog) to evaluate performance, accuracy, and scalability. Developed a custom authentication solution using ASP.NET and RESTful APIs to ensure seamless integration with existing systems. Achieved 80%+ accuracy in user authentication and reduced false positives by 15% through optimized algorithms.
